js: await __sleep(6000);const g=window.__carGround;const car=window.__car;car.updateMatrixWorld(true);const v=new (car.position.constructor)();const mins={};for(const n of ['WheelFrontL','WheelFrontR','WheelRearL','WheelRearR']){const w=car.getObjectByName(n);let y=1e9,x0=1e9,x1=-1e9,z0=1e9,z1=-1e9;w.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh){const p=o.geometry.getAttribute('position');for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){v.fromBufferAttribute(p,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld);y=Math.min(y,v.y);x0=Math.min(x0,v.x);x1=Math.max(x1,v.x);z0=Math.min(z0,v.z);z1=Math.max(z1,v.z)}}});mins[n]={minY:+y.toFixed(4),cx:+((x0+x1)/2).toFixed(3),cz:+((z0+z1)/2).toFixed(3)}}return JSON.stringify({measured:{spread_m:+g.spread.toFixed(4),offset:g.offset.map(n=>+n.toFixed(3))},wheelsNow:mins})
